purpose: Datacube audit/refactor receipt for reducing near-failing published example bytes and ratcheting the package boundary without adding registry doctrine.
riskSelected: Package examples had only 164 bytes of headroom at rev0199, making ordinary product examples impossible without budget drift.

changes.change: Deduplicated repeated store/scheduler/adapter setup through a local makeLane helper and shared encoder helper.
Deduplicated repeated postured guarded-storage proof checks through compact local predicates.
Deduplicated cross-tab postured guarded-storage checks and shortened receipt prose.
Ratcheted examplesBytesMax from 225,000 to 220,000 and made the audit self-check the new string.
Stamped package_stamp and package_timestamp together with filenames so check_cube cannot see linked package filename/stamp split-brain.

forwardRisk: Package src remains within about 1.4 KB of its ratchet and needs structural relief next.
The package still publishes proof-heavy demos/examples; future user-value demos need a smaller installed surface.
OPFS byte-time/privacy posture is still future work and should not be papered over by more receipt prose.
nonClaims: No runtime promotion, npm publication, source split, OPFS durability, quota reservation, eviction survival, fsync durability, Storage Buckets support, Web Lock fairness, privacy guarantee, browser crash recovery, or cross-browser proof is claimed.
